description: This file contains implementation of process management functions for executing and managing child processes, including command execution, environment setup, process cleanup, signal handling, and parallel process management within the Git project.

methods.name: child_process_init
methods.description: Initializes a child_process structure to default values.

methods.name: child_process_clear
methods.description: Clears the arguments and environment vectors of a child_process.

methods.name: is_executable
methods.description: Checks if a given file is an executable regular file.

methods.name: locate_in_PATH
methods.description: Searches the system PATH for an executable file matching the given name.

methods.name: exists_in_PATH
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: sane_execvp
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments, with tracing and error handling.

methods.name: git_shell_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the shell executable used by Git.

methods.name: prepare_shell_cmd
methods.description: Prepares a shell command for execution, handling special characters.

methods.name: start_command
methods.description: Starts a child process with proper setup of pipes, environment, and execution.

methods.name: finish_command
methods.description: Waits for a child process to finish and cleans up.

methods.name: finish_command_in_signal
methods.description: Waits for a child process to finish, handling signals.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Runs a command by starting and then waiting for it to complete.

methods.name: start_async
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous process with optional pipes and threading.

methods.name: finish_async
methods.description: Waits for an asynchronous process to complete.

methods.name: async_with_fork
methods.description: Determines if asynchronous execution uses fork.

methods.name: pipe_command
methods.description: Executes a command with input/output pipes, handling I/O multiplexing.

methods.name: run_processes_parallel
methods.description: Runs multiple processes in parallel with control over concurrency and output.

methods.name: prepare_auto_maintenance
methods.description: Prepares a maintenance command based on repository configuration.

methods.name: run_auto_maintenance
methods.description: Runs automatic maintenance tasks if configured.

methods.name: prepare_other_repo_env
methods.description: Prepares environment variables for a different repository.

methods.name: start_bg_command
methods.description: Starts a background command with timeout and callback handling.

methods.name: check_pipe
methods.description: Checks for broken pipe errors and handles SIGPIPE.
